verses.text: Moses called all Israel together and said, “Israel, listen to the laws and rulings I’m giving you today. Learn them and make sure you live by them.”
Yahweh our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
Yahweh made this covenant with us, every one of us alive here today, and not with our ancestors.
Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain, right from the middle of the fire.
I stood between Yahweh and you that day to tell you what he said, because the fire scared you and you didn’t go up the mountain. He said:
“I’m Yahweh your God. I brought you out of Egypt, out of the place where you were slaves.
“Have no other gods before me.
“Don’t carve an image for yourself in the shape of anything in heaven above, on the earth below, or in the waters under the earth.

Don’t bow down to those images or serve them. I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God. I bring the consequences of the parents’ wrongdoing on their children, to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me.
But I show faithful love to thousands who love me and keep my commands.
“Don’t misuse the name of Yahweh your God. Yahweh won’t let anyone who misuses his name go guilt-free.
“Keep the Sabbath day holy, just as Yahweh your God told you.
Work for six days and do everything you need to do.

The seventh day is a Sabbath for Yahweh your God. Nobody does any work that day: you, your son, your daughter, your male or female servant, your ox, your donkey, any of your livestock, or the foreigner living in your town. Your servants should get to rest just like you do.
Remember that you were a slave in Egypt. Yahweh your God brought you out with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That’s why Yahweh your God told you to keep the Sabbath.
“Honor your father and mother, just as Yahweh your God told you, so you’ll live long and things will go well for you in the land Yahweh your God is giving you.
“Don’t murder.
“Don’t commit adultery.
“Don’t steal.
“Don’t give false testimony against your neighbor.
“Don’t covet your neighbor’s wife. Don’t set your sights on your neighbor’s house, field, male or female servant, ox, donkey, or anything else they own.”

Yahweh spoke those words in a loud voice to your whole assembly on the mountain, from the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness. He added nothing more. He wrote the words on two stone tablets and handed them to me.
When you heard the voice from the middle of the darkness while the mountain burned with fire, your tribal leaders and elders all came over to me.
You said, “Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and greatness. We heard his voice right out of the fire. Today we’ve seen that God can speak to a person and that person can live.
So why should we die now? This huge fire will swallow us up. If we hear Yahweh our God speak again, we’ll die.
Who else has heard the living God speaking from the middle of a fire the way we did and lived?
You go closer and listen to everything Yahweh our God says. Then tell us everything he tells you. We’ll listen and do it.”
Yahweh heard what you said to me. He told me, “I heard what these people said to you. They were right in everything they said.
If only their hearts would stay like this, so they’d honor me with reverence and keep all my commands always. Then things would go well for them and their children forever!
“Go tell them to head back to their tents.
You stay here with me. I’ll give you all the commands, laws, and rulings you’re to teach them, so they can live by them in the land I’m giving them to own.”
So be careful to do what Yahweh your God commanded you. Don’t turn off to the right or the left.
Follow the whole path Yahweh your God laid out for you. Then you’ll live, things will go well for you, and you’ll spend many years in the land you’re going to possess.
